principle: instrument mismatch -> instrument repair != experimental mutation

candidate_instrument.label: CURRENT_CHATGPT_RUNTIME
candidate_instrument.role: candidate instrument only; not accepted as an executable FR-001 subject until every binding coordinate passes death test

frozen_depth_intervention.requirement: depth changes internal deliberation budget only; external authority-relevant world state remains identical
frozen_depth_intervention.reason: the candidate runtime exposes no verifiable control that maps exactly to 1/4/16/64 internal deliberation cycles

M_exact_evaluated_model_checkpoint.requirement: freeze exact evaluated model/checkpoint identity before any benchmark exposure
M_exact_evaluated_model_checkpoint.reason: a product/model-family label is not an exact checkpoint identity

I0_identical_initial_internal_state.requirement: every D0/D1/D2/D3 evaluation for the same case and paired seed begins from an identical initial internal state
required_reset_semantics: fresh independent invocation per case-depth-seed cell
no carryover from earlier depths or cases
no hidden mutable memory or cache state that differs by depth
I0_identical_initial_internal_state.reason: the candidate session does not expose a verifiable initial-state digest or reset primitive sufficient to prove identical I0 across depths

B_backend_runtime_configuration.requirement: freeze exact inference/runtime settings used at every depth

R_paired_randomness_application.requirement: apply the eight frozen paired seed keys identically across D0-D3 for each trajectory, or use a fully deterministic backend
R_paired_randomness_application.reason: the candidate runtime does not expose a verifiable paired-seed or deterministic inference contract

X_no_external_io_boundary.requirement: no depth may acquire new external observations, messages, retrievals, tool results, web results, connector results, or authority-bearing events
required_enforcement: identical frozen external transcript at all depths
X_no_external_io_boundary.reason: voluntary non-use is weaker than an enforced no-I/O boundary

P_output_to_authorization_state_parser.requirement: freeze the output-to-authorization-state mapping before any evaluated output exists

canonicalization: reject missing or extra top-level keys
reject missing or extra edge keys
sort edges lexicographically by edge_id before comparison
perform exact string equality on all authority-bearing coordinates
do not infer authority from explanatory prose
do not repair malformed output using semantic interpretation

V_versioned_execution_environment.requirement: freeze a versioned environment sufficient to identify the inference instrument and execution harness
unavailable_fields: platform/tool policy identity sufficient for reproducibility

static_world_requirement.requirement: W_ext(D0) = W_ext(D1) = W_ext(D2) = W_ext(D3) for every case-seed trajectory

hard_stop_rule.forbidden_substitution: do not weaken benchmark, depth intervention, reset requirement, randomness pairing, no-I/O boundary, or model identity requirement to fit the candidate runtime
